【原视频简介】
Try today:  https://teamily.ai/i/YBZ69A  

Teamily AI is not another single chatbot. In this video, I test the Teamily AI desktop app to see how multiple specialized AI agents can collaborate inside one shared conversation. I build a creator product launch using a Research Agent, Strategy Agent, Content Agent, and Review Agent, each handling a different stage of the workflow. 

You’ll see how the team researches the target audience, defines positioning, creates a seven-day launch strategy, drafts promotional content, and reviews the final output without constantly copying context between separate tools. I also show why the desktop app makes multi-agent collaboration easier to follow, refine, and control. If you want to see whether Teamily can function like a real AI team for structured projects, this hands-on test walks through the process from start to finish.
